title: DBSCAN Clustering
text: 对检测结果进行聚类，输入 3 路、输出 2 路；按 {Cluster threshold epsilon} 指定聚类邻域大小；{Define outputs for Simulink block} 指定聚类数据输出类型 Index、{Source of cluster threshold epsilon} 指定 Epsilon 来源、{Minimum number of points in a cluster} 指定聚类所需的最小点数、{Maximum number of points for ’Auto’ epsilon} 指定聚类所需的最大点数、{Length of cluster threshold epsilon history} 指定聚类阈值 epsilon 历史长度、{Enable disambiguation of dimensions} 启用消歧、{Indices of ambiguous dimensions} 指定模糊维度索引、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 输入数据 N -by- P real-valued matrix

ports.name: Update
ports.summary: 启用 epsilon 自动更新 false (default) | true

ports.name: AmbLims
ports.summary: 模糊度限值 1-by-2 real-valued vector (default) | 2-by-2 real-valued matrix

ports.name: Idx
ports.summary: 聚类索引 N -by-1 integer-valued column vector

ports.name: Clusters
ports.summary: 替代聚类 ID 1-by- N integer-valued row vector

params.name: Define outputs for Simulink block
params.values: 聚类数据输出类型 Index and ID (default) | Cluster ID | Index

params.name: Cluster threshold epsilon
params.values: 聚类邻域大小 10.0 (default) | positive scalar | positive real-valued 1-by- P row vector

params.name: Minimum number of points in a cluster
params.values: 聚类所需的最小点数 3 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Maximum number of points for ’Auto’ epsilon
params.values: 聚类所需的最大点数 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Length of cluster threshold epsilon history
params.values: 聚类阈值 epsilon 历史长度 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Indices of ambiguous dimensions
params.values: 模糊维度索引 1 (default) | positive integer | 1-by-2 vector of positive integers

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
